copyFallback: Copy did not work. Press and hold the message, select all, and copy.
takeToPerson: Give or send this to a person. There is no inbox on this site.
inWeChat: You are already inside WeChat. Go back to your chat and paste it.
phoneAlso: A call or a text works too. This device may not be yours, and WeChat may not be logged in.
officialCheck: Cross-check this contact against the Consulate or TAAN's own official post.
askSent: Have you given or sent this yet?
markSent: I have given or sent this
readyUnsent: You have a message ready that has not been marked given or sent.
markedSent: Marked given or sent on this device. Send updates the same way, quoting your note.
editAgain: Change the details and prepare again
storageWarn: This browser could not save a draft. If you close the page, the answers are gone.
sharedPhone: This may be a shared phone. Clear this device when you are done.
noteExplain: Your note (not a tracking number. We cannot look this up). Use the same words if you send an update later.
noscript: This form needs JavaScript. If it is off, copy the fields below onto paper.
noscriptAssemble: This page cannot assemble the trilingual card without JavaScript.
validation: Fill the fields marked with an error.
retypeIdHint: Not saved on this device. Please type it again.
dangerLink: If you need to call, pick Nepal or China
minorStop: Do not continue this form for an unaccompanied minor. Stay with the child if it is safe. Call Child Helpline 1098, or Police 100.
